blueprint.summary: Washington Commanders hold $23.16M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($23.16M effective) and +$70.18M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Adam Peters and the Commanders front office hold $23.16M in gross 2026 cap space ($23.16M effective), while 2027 currently projects at +$70.18M under an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($16M–$20M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Sam Cosmi, Dorance Armstrong, K'Lavon Chaisson, Frankie Luvu.

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($16M–$20M Target vs. +$70.18M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Washington's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
